sections.title: What we do
sections.text: SEO is our core specialty, and our other services build the foundation it runs on: a solid website or store and well-organized product content.

items.label: Search engine optimization
items.text: The work SEO House was built on: analyzing search demand, fixing the site's technical issues, building content and authority, then measuring the impact on leads.

items.label: Website design & development
items.text: Websites built around your business goals: a clear message, speed, easy management and a technical foundation ready for SEO work later on.

items.label: Online store design & development
items.text: Stores built for easy buying: clear categories, persuasive product pages, and payment and shipping that work without friction.

sections.label: Product upload & content management
sections.text_2: Adding products with their data, images and categories in an organized way, so your store runs smoothly and shows up in search without messy data.

items.question: Can I hire you for just one service?
items.answer: Yes. We can work on SEO alone, on building your website or store alone, or only on product upload, depending on what your project needs.

items.question: Which service is right for an existing website that isn't generating leads?
items.answer: We usually start with an SEO review to find what's stopping your pages from ranking and converting, then decide whether the website itself needs development work.

items.question: Do you build the website and then leave?
items.answer: Handover includes a walkthrough of how to manage the site and a transfer of all access rights. After that, we can agree on monthly support for ongoing optimization and measurement.

items.question: Do you use ready-made platforms or custom development?
items.answer: We work with WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Salla, Zid and WooCommerce, and we build custom solutions when ready-made platforms don't fit the system you need.

items.question: How is pricing determined?
items.answer: Pricing depends on the scope of work, the size of your website or catalog, and how competitive your market is. Check our pricing page, then book a call to discuss your project.
